items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Oh, I was a man. You know Udell Wilson. Oh, Udell, yes, indeed. Who wouldn't know Udell? Yes, indeed.

ctx.x: Oh, I was a man. You know Udell Wilson. Oh, Udell, yes, indeed. Who wouldn't know Udell? Yes, indeed. Yeah, Udell. And this other piano player, I'm trying to think of his name, he went to Chicago, never come back. New York, at least.
Do you remember Frank Ahamia? Frank Ahamia, no, I don't remember that.
